_comment: A small, hand-constructed lockfile for testing transitive dependency scanning, matching the real lockfileVersion 3 shape (see demo/package-lock.json for a full real one generated via actual npm install). lodash and axios mirror two of tests/fixtures/manifest.json's direct dependencies; the rest are invented transitive-only entries with no fixture coverage, used to prove the scanning mechanism degrades gracefully (lookup_failed, not a crash) rather than to assert specific severities.
